meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 先制定决策完备的开发计划，再动手写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次动手开发前都想先把计划想清楚
copy.tagline_en: Map out an actionable work plan before you start coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear plan ready before touching code

howto.what: 它变成一位只做规划的顾问:先翻阅你的代码并做只读研究,只在确实无法判断时才向你提问;得到你明确同意后,写出一份执行者不用再追问的完整工作计划,然后交给执行环节。它自己不写、不改任何代码。
howto.when: 只在你自己明确要求时触发:说“ulw-plan”“make a plan”等关键词,或用自己的话要求在写代码前先做计划。若你说“do X”“build X”,它也按规划模式处理,只做计划不实现。

say.text: ulw-plan:先别写代码,把登录改造做成一份完整计划。
say.note: 它先探索代码,只问必要问题,你点头后写计划。

say.text: make a plan,给 /login 加每 IP 每分钟 5 次的限流。
say.note: 意图明确时它只问探索定不了的问题,等你批准。

say.text: plan before coding,把权限模块拆成可执行计划。
say.note: 意图模糊时它自己研究并采用默认方案,自动附高精度复查。

howto.what_en: Turns into a planning-only consultant: reads and searches your code, asks only what exploration can't resolve, waits for your OK, then writes one ready-to-execute work plan. It never edits product code.
howto.when_en: When you explicitly ask: say "ulw-plan", "make a plan", "plan before coding", etc., or ask for a plan before coding. Even "do X"/"build X" means plan mode - it plans only, never implements.

say_en.text: ulw-plan: don't code yet, make a complete work plan for the login rework.
say_en.note: Explores, asks only what's unresolvable, plans after OK.

say_en.text: make a plan: add a 5/min per-IP rate limit to /login.
say_en.note: Routes as clear intent, asks only real forks, waits for OK.

say_en.text: plan before coding: break the permission module into an executable plan.
say_en.note: Fuzzy: picks defaults, auto-runs high-accuracy review.
